hints.title: Tree Centers
hints.text: Connecting the centers of the two trees minimizes the distance between any pair of nodes spanning across both trees.

hints.title: Radius Formula
hints.text: For a tree with diameter D, its radius (distance from center to furthest leaf) is ceil(D / 2) = (D + 1) // 2.

hints.title: Combined Diameter Bound
hints.text: The new diameter is max(D1, D2, radius1 + radius2 + 1). Use two BFS traversals to compute the diameter of each tree.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Two BFS passes per tree to determine diameters in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all possible connecting edges takes O(n * m) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n + m) adjacency lists and distance buffers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Find tree diameters via double BFS and connect their tree centers optimally.
